scenes.institution: UCLA Basic Plasma Science Facility — Large Plasma Device

Long pink magnetic-coil train, dense side diagnostic ports, probe drives and service cabinets are clear. Facility page describes computer-controlled probe positioning. Photograph is credited to UCLA BaPSF by official newsroom. Overview and upgraded-device pages contain different historical plasma lengths/coil counts; do not mix them into an asserted exact as-built model. No plasma generation, field solution or fusion simulation.

Repeated side ports with long horizontal probe drive rods mounted on independent supports.
Dense overhead hose distribution, local pump carts and control cabinets along the service aisle.

scenes.title: PARADIM Bulk-Crystal Feed Inspection Bay
scenes.institution: Johns Hopkins PARADIM Bulk Crystal Growth Facility
scenes.reference_notes: Official PARADIM room panorama and four-mirror xenon furnace detail inspected. Page explicitly locates bulk crystal growth at Johns Hopkins, distinct from Cornell thin-film facilities. Room has a central long preparation island, multiple large furnace cabinets, overhead utility drops and a high service ceiling. Panorama is distorted and lacks calibrated dimensions. Xenon detail is a separate instrument view; exact room registration remains unverified. No crystal-growth kinetics, furnace heat transfer, high-pressure operation or OEM CAD. Source announces 2026 program changes; current access arrangements are not established by these images.
observed_cues: Long central wood-top preparation island surrounded by large furnace cabinets and clear side aisles.
Blue tall furnace cabinet at the rear, white equipment on the side walls and densely exposed ducts above.
Four-mirror xenon instrument detail shows symmetric metal mirror housings, tall support rods and paired cooling fans.

scenes.title: Alberta nanoFAB ExactaCoat dry alignment workstation
scenes.institution: University of Alberta nanoFAB — ExactaCoat lithography workstation
scenes.reference_notes: Official installation photograph inspected: enclosed Sono-Tek ExactaCoat gantry system on a sturdy open-frame table in amber lithography lighting. Transparent front door exposes the traversing head and cable chain; upper extraction duct and external handheld controls are visible. Official text places this tool at ECERF W1-031. Only the installed workstation is photographed. Manufacturer envelope, nozzle dimensions and axis travel are not documented here. No spray/aerosol transport, coating chemistry or deposition thickness physics; geometric dry positioning only.
observed_cues: Amber-lit enclosed gantry with a wide transparent front access door.
Visible horizontal carriage, cable chain and lowered dispensing-head assembly.
Top exhaust duct, right-side emergency stop/handheld controllers, and grounded open-frame support table.
